intro.label: Introduction
intro.heading: Rethinking Resource Scarcity
intro.body: We've reimagined livestock feed using drought-resilient, locally produced nopal cactus. Our proprietary formula transforms nopal cactus from a hardy desert plant into a complete livestock feed designed to rival conventional feed-while delivering year-round availability at a more stable, competitive price.

about.header.heading: Our Story
about.story.label: Our Story
about.story.heading: Every great solution starts with a simple question.
about.story.quote: Why are livestock producers in some of the world's driest regions still dependent on imported feed crops that require so much water?
about.story.body: So we set out to transform the nopal cactus—one of nature's most resilient plants—into a complete livestock feed that addresses the challenges of drought, unstable feed supplies, and rising costs, while delivering the nutrition and protein animals need to thrive.
